ui.tooltips.collapse.note: 'Σύμπτυξη' is standard UI term for collapse.

ui.tooltips.deselect_all.note: 'Αποεπιλογή' is a back-formation not standard in Greek; 'Κατάργηση επιλογής όλων' is more idiomatic.

ui.tooltips.expand.note: 'Ανάπτυξη' is standard UI term for expand.

ui.tooltips.rate_session.note: The German says 'Sitzung bewerten' (rate session), but the Greek adds 'αυτής της' (of this), making it slightly more verbose than the source.

ui.tooltips.read_aloud.note: 'Ανάγνωση φωναχτά' is literal but slightly unnatural; 'Ανάγνωση δυνατά' is more idiomatic in Greek UI contexts.

ui.tooltips.reanalyze.note: 'Επανάληψη ανάλυσης' means 'repetition of analysis' (noun phrase), whereas the German is a verb phrase 'run analysis again'. A verbal form would be more idiomatic.
